Maristow Chiropractic is based in Westbury, Wiltshire. We have over 22 years experience in the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of muscle, joint, tendon, ligament and nerve problems. Telephone to make an appointment to see one of our qualified and experienced chiropractors 01373 865533 or book via our website.

These videos are intended to demonstrate some of the most regular exercises we recommend to our patients. However we would not advise carrying any of them out without first speaking to a healthcare professional.  

Whether you have back or joint pain following sports, work or hobbies such as gardening, or aches and pains from general wear and tear, we may be able to help alleviate your symptoms with a personal plan and tailored treatment programme. We are committed to delivering the highest quality neuromusculoskeletal care to every patient, specific to their needs.
